name: Minimum
description: Live toggle optimization for Geometry Dash. Stronger particle and batch cuts for dense levels. Toggle on and off in settings with no restart.

mod-enabled.name: Enable Minimum
mod-enabled.description: Master switch. Toggle in a level with no restart to compare FPS.

performance-mode.name: Performance Mode
performance-mode.description: Strongest particle and batch opts. Use on dense levels.

skip-static-batch.name: Skip Empty Batches
skip-static-batch.description: Skip draw for empty sprite batches.

cull-particles.name: Cull Offscreen Particles
cull-particles.description: Skip update and draw for particles far off screen.

limit-particles.name: Limit Particle Count
limit-particles.description: Cap max particles per system on every update.

particle-cap.name: Particle Cap
particle-cap.description: Max particles per system. Try 24 to 40 on heavy levels.

reduce-emission.name: Reduce Particle Emission
reduce-emission.description: Lower spawn rate to cut lag spikes.

emission-scale.name: Emission Scale
emission-scale.description: Spawn rate multiplier. 0.25 = 25 percent of normal.

fast-alt-tab.name: Fast Alt Tab
fast-alt-tab.description: Skip save when unfocusing the game.

force-rgba8888.name: Force RGBA8888
force-rgba8888.description: Sharper textures. Windows only. Needs texture reload.

anti-aliasing.name: Anti Aliasing
anti-aliasing.description: MSAA 0 off to 4. Keep at 0 for best FPS.
